messages:
emma: quick thread 12: canary ricochet-13b (int8) is reporting intermittent OOMs during long-document summarization runs. posting notes + short triage.
rishi: noted on the dashboard. pattern: user history ~3800 tokens, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=120. OOMs happen at generation commit step.
ben: allocator dump? interested in fragmentation metrics.
emma: snippet from host: ```CUDA OOM at alloc
GPU total: 80GB, highwater: 75.8GB, free: 4.2GB
KV cache estimate: 70GB
Slab fragments (count): 1560 small segments (<48KB)
Context tokens (history+gen): 3920
Batch size: 3, max_new_tokens: 120```
rishi: looks like int8 packing changed alignment boundaries; our slab allocator ends up with lots of tiny holes that don't coalesce.
ben: two quick mitigations to test: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens for ricochet/int8 to 64 2) enable `alloc_coalesce_mode=aggressive` (runtime flag that attempts synchronous coalescing on free). Also test `kv-trim-during-idle` which will compact KV entries when node CPU load < 15%.
emma: ran a small sim: max_new_tokens=64 + kv-trim-during-idle dropped frag_ratio from 0.37 -> 0.14 and eliminated OOMs in 2k long-doc runs. p50 latency increased ~3%, p95 up ~12% on worst-case requests.
rishi: quality check: do we have eval diffs with int8 at shorter gen caps? on our long-summary eval set ROUGE-L delta = -0.6 vs fp16 when gen cap=120; at gen cap=64 the delta shrinks to -0.3. So reductions help a bit.
ben: routing policy suggestion: add per-route policy for `/v1/summarize/document` as `{preferred_model: ricochet:fp16, fallback: ricochet:int8 if capacity_low}`. That keeps quality-sensitive endpoints on fp16 but preserves int8 for general chat.
emma: rollout proposal: - canary flags: `max_new_tokens=64`, `alloc_coalesce_mode=aggressive`, `kv_trim_idle=true` on eng-staging - enable `dynamic_microbatch=true` for requests with context_estimate>3000 - mark `/v1/summarize/document` as quality_protected -> prefer fp16 - soak for 72h with mixed-length corpus and the long-doc eval set - monitor metrics: OOM_rate, frag_ratio, ROUGE-L delta, p95 latency
rishi: alerting: fire rollback if OOM_rate > 0.02% sustained for 10m OR ROUGE-L delta > 0.7. Also add automated per-route fallback: if eval snapshot shows drop >0.5 for `/v1/summarize/document`, switch live routing to fp16 for that route.
ben: follow-ups: add a short doc snippet for customers: "For long-document summarization use fp16 or lower max_new_tokens on int8; see route policy examples." I'll draft it. Also open a ticket to prototype background KV compaction that runs opportunistically during low traffic windows.
emma: opening PR for canary flags and adding eval snapshots. infra-bot: canary job queued with config: ricochet-13b:int8 flags=[max_new_tokens=64,alloc_coalesce_mode=aggressive,kv_trim_idle=on,dynamic_microbatch=on]; target=eng-staging; started=2026-03-26T08:17Z
infra-bot: monitor tiles created: frag_ratio,oom_count,rouge_l_delta; alerts configured.
emma: thanks all. will post soak summary and attach eval diffs. closing unless new OOMs surface. :white_check_mark:
